plain: A UFO researcher named Clas Svahn tells of a woman in Sweden who, sometime in the 1930s, says she saw three objects shaped like plus signs rolling along a road. Svahn passes this on second-hand, from someone he spoke to, and mentions calling his mother about it. If true, it would be a strange sighting from long before UFOs were widely talked about.
